typescript.snippet.atry: try / catch with an unknown error
typescript.type.Array: Array: Array<T> can also be written T[].
typescript.type.Awaited: Awaited<T>: the type obtained by awaiting a promise.
typescript.type.Capitalize: Capitalize<S>: the string S with an uppercase first letter.
typescript.type.Exclude: Exclude<T, U>: the members of the union T that are not in U.
typescript.type.Extract: Extract<T, U>: the members of the union T that are in U.
typescript.type.InstanceType: InstanceType<C>: the type of the instances of the class C.
typescript.type.Lowercase: Lowercase<S>: the string S in lowercase, at the type level.
typescript.type.NonNullable: NonNullable<T>: T without null or undefined.
typescript.type.Omit: Omit<T, K>: T without the properties K.
typescript.type.Parameters: Parameters<F>: the types of the parameters of the function F, as a tuple.
typescript.type.Partial: Partial<T>: T with all its properties optional.
typescript.type.Pick: Pick<T, K>: T narrowed to the properties K.
typescript.type.Promise: Future result of an asynchronous operation.
typescript.type.Readonly: Readonly<T>: T with all its properties read-only.
typescript.type.Record: Record<K, V>: object whose keys are of type K and values of type V.
typescript.type.Required: Required<T>: T with all its properties required.
typescript.type.ReturnType: ReturnType<F>: the return type of the function F.
typescript.type.Uppercase: Uppercase<S>: the string S in uppercase, at the type level.
typescript.type.WeakMap: Map whose object keys are not held.
typescript.type.never: Type of the values that never exist (a function that never returns).
typescript.type.object: Anything that is not a primitive value.
typescript.type.symbol: Unique value usable as a key.
typescript.type.unknown: Value of an unknown type: check it before any use.
typescript.type.void: No value, the result of a function that returns nothing.
